rules.title: Null safety
rules.text: Avoid !!; model absence with nullable types and handle it explicitly.

rules.title: val and data classes
rules.text: Prefer val, immutable collections and data classes.

rules.title: Structured concurrency
rules.text: Use structured concurrency with coroutines and never GlobalScope.

rules.title: Sealed hierarchies
rules.text: Model closed variants with sealed classes and use exhaustive when.

rules.title: Extension functions
rules.text: Use extension functions for utilities and keep them close to their domain.

rules.title: Flow for streams
rules.text: Use Flow for asynchronous streams and collect lifecycle-aware on Android.
